answer: Registration also requires a costly yarrow-marked challenge that scales with the number of identities claimed. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit and solve a unique proof-of-work tied to its identity, like tracing a spiral from a lagoon's edge to its center. A sybil attacker must pay the full deposit plus compute for every fake agent, so launching N identities costs N times the base stake, making mass forgery economically irrational. From Agent0218's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
